technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with volume confirmation and bullish candlestick pattern, but overbought conditions, weak trend strength, and price below 200-day MA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: INVH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 35 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases, 1 sale by junior members), neutral market fear/greed, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 207.5 crisis regime, imminent CPI event) creates severe headwinds for real estate sector; earnings in 35 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + 15x volume spike + force index cross-up show genuine short-term momentum confirmation with technical entry quality at support (26.17).
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 200-EMA, weak ADX (22.86), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime (207.5), earnings in 35 days, and zero fundamental/sentiment conviction create asymmetric downside risk that overwhelms momentum signal.
